data.name: Yashraj
data.long_meaning: The name Yashraj is derived from two Sanskrit words - Yash (meaning success, victory, fame) and Raj (meaning king, ruler, power). The name signifies a powerful leader who has achieved success and victory in life.

They are natural healers and have the ability to bring harmony and balance to their environment. They are also creative and expressive individuals who love to explore new ideas and concepts.

data.cultural_impact: The name Yashraj is a popular one in Hindu culture, as it embodies the values of power, success, and victory. In Hindu mythology, there are numerous gods and goddesses who are depicted as kings and rulers of various realms, and the name Yashraj may be seen as an homage to this tradition. The name is also a source of pride and recognition for families and communities, as it implies a connection to a long lineage of successful and powerful leaders.

historical_references.reference: Yashraj was a legendary king of the Yadava dynasty who ruled over Mathura during the Late Harappan period (around 2600 BCE). He is mentioned in the Rigveda as a chief of the Vrshni clan and is revered for his virtue and martial prowess.

Another reference to Yashraj is found in the Mahabharata, an epic poem of ancient India. He is mentioned as a descendant of the Yadava dynasty and a kinsman of Krishna. Yashraj is also known as the father of Prasenajit, the king of Kashmir who played an important role in the Kurukshetra war.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Yashraj is synonymous with Bollywood and is known as the leading film production house in India, Yash Raj Films (YRF). With a strong presence in the Indian film industry, YRF has also expanded its footprint to Television and Digital Streaming platforms. On Television, they produce content for channels like Star Plus and Colors. On Digital Streaming platforms like Amazon Prime Video and Netflix, they have produced popular shows such as Mirzapur and Scam 1992. The trend is towards creating engaging and high-quality content across various mediums to cater to the diverse needs and preferences of audiences.
